language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and grasps the wooden spoon at frames 68–95, then lifts and carries it toward the open drawer at frames 100–160 (image, left_ego_image, wrist_image). At frames 164–169, wrist_image shows the gripper opening and the spoon descending into the drawer; frames 175–178 show the spoon resting inside as the empty gripper withdraws. No failed acquisition, unwanted collision, or other side effect is visibly established.
